body: Low severity. In the deferred branch no KEPUB Data row exists yet, so Kobo metadata advertises the source EPUB's byte size for a declared KEPUB download. Measurements across 24 books with both formats show kepub/epub = 1.023, making this approximately a 2% overstatement and a proven-working estimate. Changing Size to 0 is untested against closed Kobo firmware and could affect free-space checks, progress reporting, or validation. The safe fix is to pre-produce the KEPUB so its real Data row size is available; the Kobo KEPUB preference feature already does this proactively for synced books.
title: Kobo deferred KEPUB download advertises the EPUB's byte size
